headline: Get Fentuft
title: How to Get Fentuft | Trade To Evolve | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Fentuft is an easy catch in Driftwise Meadow. To evolve it into Fenmane, you need three things. First, raise Fentuft to level forty two. Second, swap any Aniimo with a friend once on your account. Third, bring one Roar Stone. The trade does not have to involve a Fentuft, and you only do it once. Who is your trading partner? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Fentuft is found in Driftwise Meadow. It evolves into Fenmane at level 42 with one Roar Stone, after you exchange an Aniimo with a friend once.
